blocks.x: This blueprint is the single source of truth for the new DataQ Soft website: navigation, information architecture, page templates and the content package behind them.

The project rebuilds DataQ Soft's web presence from a generalist IT-services site into a Fortune-500-grade deep-tech property. The content foundation was extracted from www.strategemist.com (65 pages across eight platform families and 13 services), then rebuilt and expanded — not copied — into a 602-page architecture spanning 12 industries, 48 sub-industries, 54 deep-tech services, 24 solutions, 8 proprietary platforms, 36 anonymized case studies and a 24-article insights library.

blocks.x: Designers: Volume pages are ordered exactly like the sitemap; each page opens with a metadata box (URL, breadcrumb, SEO fields). Developers: the URL Path column in the inventory is the routing contract; template names map 1:1 to the templates in Chapter 5. Editors: every 【…】 placeholder is information only the company can supply — a consolidated checklist lives in Chapter 8.

Strategemist's deep-tech voice — patent-backed platforms, outcome-linked engagements, zero-exposure security — is preserved as a family resemblance, but every sentence in this package was rebuilt for DataQ Soft's positioning. No paragraph was carried over verbatim. Where Strategemist offered one proof style (anonymized outcomes), this package industrializes it: 36 case skeletons, committed outcome ranges per service, and regulatory context per industry.

DataQ Soft is a global IT services and consulting company that engineers the intelligence layer of the enterprise. We unite applied AI, agentic automation, data platforms, cybersecurity and emerging compute into eight proprietary platforms and outcome-linked engagements that produce measured, auditable business results.
